name: SKS Technologies Group Limited
summary: SKS Technologies Group Limited engages in the design, supply, and installation of audio visual, electrical, and communication products and services in Australia. It offers audiovisual integration, automated audiovisual systems, digital signage, AV over IP networks, room control systems, command and control systems, large screens and stadiums, hi-tech intuitive corporate boardrooms, hi-tech intuitive training rooms, display and projector systems, whiteboards, touch panel control, public address systems, video and audio conferencing, maintenance contracts, as well as maintenance and support services for architects, builders, and consultants.
